resources.string: Files you secure are encrypted on this device. TrueVault will always tell you whether the original is still visible somewhere else.
Try a shorter search. TrueVault searches file names only, and only inside your vault.
Nothing could be saved. The files are still in your vault.
Saved %1$d, could not save %2$d. Nothing was removed from the vault.

plurals.name: vault_save_body
plurals.item: This writes an unprotected copy of %1$d file back to your device. Photos and videos go to your gallery; other files are saved where you choose. Anyone with the phone can then open it.
This writes unprotected copies of %1$d files back to your device. Photos and videos go to your gallery; other files are saved where you choose. Anyone with the phone can then open them.

plurals.name: vault_export_saved
plurals.item: Saved %1$d file to your device. It is still in your vault too.
Saved %1$d files to your device. They are still in your vault too.

plurals.name: vault_export_unhidden
plurals.item: Unhid %1$d file. It is back on your device and moved to the vault trash.
Unhid %1$d files. They are back on your device and moved to the vault trash.

resources.string: This file is secured, but TrueVault cannot preview this format.
Your file is stored and encrypted exactly as it was. Preview for videos and PDFs is not part of this build.
Preview shortened. The stored file is complete.
The vault locked while this file was open.
This file could not be opened. Its encrypted contents failed verification, so nothing was shown.

plurals.name: vault_delete_body
plurals.item: This permanently removes %1$d encrypted file from TrueVault. It cannot be undone, and files outside TrueVault are not affected.
This permanently removes %1$d encrypted files from TrueVault. It cannot be undone, and files outside TrueVault are not affected.

resources.string: Once another app receives this file, TrueVault cannot control its copies. There is no expiry and no way to take it back.
The copy TrueVault writes back to your device is no longer protected — anyone with the phone can open it. A photo or video goes to your gallery; anything else is saved where you choose.
Saved to your device. Still in your vault too.
Unhidden. Moved to the vault trash.
Could not save this file. It is still in your vault.
Items you delete from the vault wait here for 30 days, still encrypted, so a mis-tap costs you nothing.
These files are still encrypted and still on this device. They are erased 30 days after deletion, or when you empty the trash.

plurals.name: trash_empty_confirm_body
plurals.item: %1$d file will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone without a backup.
%1$d files will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone without a backup.
